concerns.text: FR-004 mandates segmenting data into 2-second epochs. Task T013 implements this, but FR-004 also mandates a minimum of ≥100 epochs per condition. Task T014 addresses the validation logic for this count, but T014 is marked incomplete (unchecked). Without T014, the pipeline cannot enforce the SC-005 power requirement or halt on underpowered data, leaving FR-004 partially unimplemented.

FR-004 requires the output to contain ≥100 epochs. Task T017 (Save preprocessed epochs to data/processed/epochs_cleaned.fif) is marked incomplete. This file is the mandatory input for T018 (Feature Extraction) and the entire downstream pipeline. Missing T017 breaks the data flow for US-1 completion.

FR-005 requires Morlet wavelet decomposition (8-30 Hz). Task T018 implements this but is marked incomplete. Without T018, the feature matrix (T023) cannot be generated, blocking FR-006 (Feature Extraction) and all downstream US-3 tasks (T025+).

FR-006 requires extracting mean power for specific electrodes. Tasks T020 and T021 implement this, but they depend on T018 (incomplete) and T019. Furthermore, T022 (Feature validation) and T023 (Save feature matrix) are incomplete. T023 is the critical output for US-2; without it, US-2 is not deliverable.

FR-007 (LDA training) and FR-008 (Permutation testing) depend on the feature matrix from T023. T025 (LDA) and T027 (Permutation) are marked incomplete. Additionally, T028 (Report p-value) and T031 (Generate results.json) are incomplete. The entire statistical validation block (US-3) is unimplemented.

FR-009 requires Family-Wise Error (FWE) correction. Task T029 implements this but is incomplete. It depends on T028a (t-tests), which is also incomplete. Without T029, SC-004 (Multiple comparison correction) cannot be measured.
FR-010 requires sensitivity analysis. Task T030 implements this but is incomplete. Without T030, SC-006 cannot be measured.
SC-002 requires validating classification accuracy against a benchmark. Task T032 handles this validation but is incomplete. Without T032, the mandatory pass/fail gating for the feature is missing.

Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) requires checksumming derived data. Task T024 (Document electrode collinearity) and T031 (Generate results.json) are incomplete. Without these, the metadata and final results required for traceability are missing.

Task T015 and T016 address edge cases (missing markers/electrodes) but are marked complete while the core pipeline tasks (T014, T017) are incomplete. This creates a false sense of readiness for the 'Edge Cases' section of the spec, as the edge case handling cannot be tested without the core pipeline running.
